summary: Tested Emergent Google social login (redirect + failure paths) and regression of email/password auth. Backend 8/8 pytest passed; frontend all flows passed. Real Google OAuth success path (new user creation / linking existing account) could not be automated.
verified: POST /api/auth/google bogus session_id -> 401 'Google sign-in failed — please try again', no cookies set
/login shows 'Continue with Google' above email field + 'or with email' divider
/app#session_id=bogus renders auth-callback then redirects to /login with toast 'Google sign-in failed — please try again'
Admin->/admin, instructor->/instructor, student->/app via UI login; session persists across reload; /me, /refresh, logout OK; register -> /onboarding
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: unique_username() can yield usernames shorter than 3 chars (e.g. 'ab@gmail.com' -> 'ab'), violating the 3-char minimum that RegisterIn enforces. Consider padding the base.
Minor: AuthCallback on failure calls setUser(false) even if the user already had valid cookies; a reload signs them back in. Harmless, but you could call refresh() instead.
Minor: google_login doesn't catch httpx network errors/timeouts (upstream outage -> 500 instead of a friendly 401/502).
seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_ users (test_ge82e1835@example.com, test_uiea40f6@example.com); both deleted by exact id/email after testing. No seeded data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Google success path (account linking keeps XP/role/plan; new user creation) needs a real Google session and was not tested. It could be tested by mocking the session-data upstream.
